finite_free_rank112_proof: For R0=QQ[a,a^-1], E monic e28 gives R0[e]/E free28. Over this ring H remains monic d4, so R0[e,d]/(E,H) is free112, irrespective of reducedness/factorization.
actual_B_bad_containment: At each FULLU B-rankbad point all maximalminors and hence f,g vanish. H is their a-unit linearcombination, so H=0; R=uf*f+vg*g=0 and the knownunit a^31*C^4 implies h=0. Therefore every B-bad point lies in V(E,H).
